model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Figure 5 (left) illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values below a specified threshold after gating, with the threshold set to 1e-2. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the depth of the network layers, ranging from 0 to 20, with integer labels at each unit interval. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," indicates the proportion of values below the threshold, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 0.2.

The figure contains three distinct lines:
1.  A solid blue line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.95 at layer 0 and decreases gradually to approximately 0.25 by layer 20.
2.  A dashed green line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," begins at approximately 0.20 at layer 0 and generally increases, reaching a peak of approximately 0.65 around layer 10, then decreases slightly to approximately 0.55 by layer 20.
3.  A dotted red line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," starts at approximately 0.20 at layer 0 and remains relatively flat, hovering near 0.20 to 0.25 across all layers up to 20.
model_annotations.Chinese: Figure 5 (left) displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2 across 21 layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linearly scaled from 0 to 20, representing the layer index. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is linearly scaled from 0.0 to 1.0, indicating the proportion of output values below the threshold. The chart contains three lines: a dashed blue line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio after gating, averaging 0.44; a solid green line with triangular markers representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, averaging 0.33; and a dotted red line with square markers representing the sparsity ratio before gating, averaging 0.03. The sparsity ratio begins near 0.0 for all lines at layer 0, increases sharply for the blue and green lines through layer 6, and then fluctuates with minor peaks and troughs, remaining relatively stable between 0.2 and 0.6 for the blue line and between 0.2 and 0.4 for the green line through layer 20, while the red line remains consistently near 0.0 throughout the entire layer range.
model_annotations.English: Figure 5 (left) plots the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2 across layers 0 to 20. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” is linear and ranges from 0 to 20. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” is linear and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot contains three lines: a dashed blue line with circle markers representing the sparsity ratio after gating, which starts at approximately 0.03 and rises to about 0.45; a solid green line with triangle markers representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, which starts at approximately 0.03 and rises to about 0.45; and a dotted red line with square markers representing the sparsity ratio before gating, which starts at approximately 0.03 and rises to about 0.45. All three lines show a general upward trend with some fluctuations, particularly for the solid green line, which has a more pronounced peak around layer 10 before declining slightly.
model_annotations.German: Figure 5 (left) displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-2 across layers, comparing the sparsity ratio before gating, after gating, and after average gating. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, and is labeled “Layer”. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2, and is labeled “Sparsity Ratio”. The solid blue line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03”, starts at approximately 0.03 and remains relatively flat with minor fluctuations, ending near 0.03. The dashed red line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44”, begins at approximately 0.44, exhibits a slight downward trend, dips to around 0.38 near layer 10, and then rises to approximately 0.44 by layer 20. The dotted green line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33”, starts at approximately 0.33, remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations, and ends near 0.33.
